changeSet.author: Gleb Zapara
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE admins( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, name TEXT NOT NULL, surname TEXT NOT NULL, email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL CHECK (email ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$'), password TEXT NOT NULL, role TEXT NOT NULL );

changeSet.author: Gleb Zapara
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE users( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, username TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL CHECK (username ~ '^@[A-Za-z0-9_]+$'), firstname TEXT NOT NULL, lastname TEXT NOT NULL, email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL CHECK (email ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$'), password TEXT NOT NULL, phone_number VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK (phone_number ~ '^\+[0-9]{9,15}$'), image TEXT, last_seen TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, role TEXT NOT NULL );

changeSet.author: Gleb Zapara
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE chats( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, name TEXT NOT NULL, image TEXT, count_messages INTEGER DEFAULT 0, type TEXT NOT NULL );

changeSet.author: Gleb Zapara
Gleb Zapara
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE messages( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, text TEXT NOT NULL, chat_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES chats(id), user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL );
